content_html:
Food Scanner & Macro Journal

Only for iPhone

Free · In‑App Purchases · Designed for iPhone. Not verified for macOS.

iPhone

Snap a meal, explore its estimated nutrition, and keep your calories, macros, water, recipes, and weight progress together in Mealumo. Build a clearer picture of your daily nutrition with Mealumo. Track meals, calories, macronutrients, water, and weight in one place, with AI photo estimates to help you start a food entry. SCAN AND REVIEW YOUR MEALS Take a meal photo or choose one from your library to estimate ingredients, portions, calories, protein, carbohydrates, and fat. Review the results, adjust portions, and edit ingredients before saving your meal. KEEP A DAILY FOOD JOURNAL See your daily calorie goal, logged meals, and macro totals. Search foods and add ingredients to keep your entries useful and personal. MAKE ROOM FOR EVERYDAY HABITS Log water, record your weight, and follow your progress over time. Explore recipe ideas for breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snacks. PERSONALIZE YOUR TARGETS Enter your goals, body measurements, and activity preferences to generate estimated daily nutrition targets. Update your personal information as your routine changes. Meal photos and the profile details needed to generate nutrition targets are sent to an external AI service for processing. An internet connection is required for AI features. Nutrition estimates may be inaccurate; review them before use. Mealumo is for general wellness and does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION Mealumo offers weekly, monthly, and yearly auto-renewable PRO subscriptions. PRO unlocks continued meal scanning, water logging, and access to the full recipe collection. Prices are displayed in the app before purchase. Payment is charged to your account at confirmation. Your subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your account settings. No free trial is included. Terms of Use: https://novlasoft.io/terms-of-use/ Privacy Policy: https://novlasoft.io/privacy-policy/
